text:
jordy: Heads-up: doing a quick tidy of troubleshooting pages today. Found a handful of stale inline snippets (old SDK name), one context-limit example that suggests >32k tokens, and two links that 404. Planning a two-PR strategy: link-only fixes first, then snippet + repro additions. Who's available?

li: I can grab the link-only pass. I'll run linkcheck and then manual spot-check anchors.

marco: I'll update the SDK snippets. We should switch samples to `redwood-sdk-python` (new import path) and add a tiny test harness in the repo to ensure snippets don't rot.

jordy: Good. For the context-limit example, replace the >32k claim with a short note: "effective context depends on model variant and tokenization; see model profiles" and link to the catalog. Don't promise a specific hard limit.

zara: Also add a short troubleshooting bullet for clients that see streaming truncation: check client-side socket timeouts + server-side per-connection token cap. People keep mixing those up.

marco: Draft python snippet I'll put in the PR: ```python
# redwood-sdk-python snippet: handle 429 with recommended helper
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=ENV.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status == 429:
    # use built-in retry helper in production
    client.retry_with_backoff(resp, max_retries=4)
```

li: I'll start the link PR: opening #9120 as link-only. Running linkcheck now.

ci-bot: docs-ci: linkcheck passed for branch li/link-fix-9120. Preview: https://deploy-previews.redwood.test/preview/7810

li: PR #9120 posted. Tagging @docs-owners for review.

marco: PR #9121 for snippets + tiny test harness (scripts/snippet-smoke.py) - includes runnable examples and CI guard. Note: switched curl sample to show `Retry-After` header and a short note about honoring server-specified wait vs aggressive client retry.

jordy: Can we also add a short step in the runbook to repro 429s in staging: replicate 50 concurrent short requests to the test route with a transient rate-limit rule (10 req/s) and assert `Retry-After` present. Add exact k6 command in the runbook.

zara: I'll add the streaming truncation note and link to the socket timeout troubleshooting in eng-runtime.

marco: Small follow-up: replaced previous `X-Retry-After` header name with `Retry-After` everywhere. Also added a sentence: "If server returns Retry-After, respect it; if not provided, use exponential backoff starting at 1s".

ci-bot: docs-ci: snippet-smoke passed for branch marco/snippets-9121. Preview: https://deploy-previews.redwood.test/preview/7811 :eyes:

jordy: Nice. Plan: merge link-only PR first (#9120), then merge snippet PR (#9121) after a short maintainers review. After merging, I'll trigger a docsite smoke to run linkcheck + snippet-smoke. If both green, we'll cut a tiny changelog entry: "docs: fix stale links, update SDK snippets, clarify context limits and streaming troubleshooting".

li: Reviewing now. If no major issues, I'll merge today.

marco: Thanks. I'll watch the preview and patch anything breaky. If we need to rollback the preview, call me or ping #eng-oncall.

jordy: Thanks team. Small wins.

ci-bot: deploy: merge queued for #9120 -> main. Preview will be invalidated and new deploy queued after #9121 merges.
